_source: The Flight design doc pp. 4-7 (hunger, courtship, mates, eggs, chicks, caches) and p. 34 (targets); numbers the doc leaves open are marked _open
_day_note: the user (2026-10-03): keep the doc's timings in days but make days and nights shorter than its 4 minutes; matches run well past day 8
_work_pace_note: 0 = 240 / day_seconds: colony birds fly and work at the pace the doc's per-day numbers (a fisher catches 3-6 fish a day) were set at
_feed_note: feed units a full hunger bar holds = what a bird eats in a game day; a fish's feed is its size (1-6). 'A sardine feeds one chick for a day' (p4).
_wild_mates_open: the doc's 'sea's wild-bird population': a finite pool per island (my default; the players compete for it)
_twigs_open: nest and cache costs: the doc says three builders raise a nest in a game hour
_regrow_open: logistic r per game day by size class; yield falls when overfished and recovers when rested (p7)
_feeder_open: without feeders every bird fetches its own and loses a third of its day (p11): a self-fetched meal takes 20 s, a handed one 2 s; one feeder serves eight workers
